source.purpose: Immutable P0.1 evidence snapshot preserved after P1.1 rewrote the live Makefile

excerpt: COMPOSE_ENV_BASE := --env-file $(ROOT_DIR)/.env
DEV_ENV_FILES := $(COMPOSE_ENV_BASE)
DEV_ENV_FILES += --env-file $(ROOT_DIR)/.env.docker when that file exists
PROD_ENV_FILES := $(COMPOSE_ENV_BASE)
PROD_ENV_FILES += --env-file $(ROOT_DIR)/.env.docker.production when that file exists
COMPOSE_DEV and COMPOSE_PROD select standalone dev/prod carriers
COMPOSE selects by ENV and MIGRATE_FORCE adds --force for prod
help advertised make up/down/build/restart/ps/logs/shell/artisan/composer/image/db/test targets
help advertised prod deploy code/runtime/image/php-deps and prod doctor variants
up required environment config and ran docker compose up -d
down ran docker compose down
build ran docker compose up -d --build
restart and ps delegated to the selected Compose carrier
test-preflight ran Compose ps and a PostgreSQL PDO connectivity probe inside app
the prod branch used non-TTY exec
test-php depended on test-preflight and db:create-test
test-php executed php artisan test --compact with DB_DATABASE=agelto_test
agent environment markers were forwarded into the app container
prod-pre-clean ran docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans with ignored failure
prod-image built agelto/app:latest
prod-composer-install ran no-dev optimized Composer without scripts and then package discovery
prod-config-cache ran artisan config:cache
prod-deploy pulled app/horizon/scheduler, optionally paused Horizon, migrated with --force, terminated Horizon, recreated services and checked status
prod-deploy-code cleared/config-cached and restarted services
prod-deploy-php-deps delegated to prod-composer-install
prod-deploy-runtime combined Composer, migration, config cache and service restart
prod-deploy-image invoked prod-pre-clean, rebuilt latest, force-recreated services and then ran runtime deploy
